type ResolveRequest struct
  Capability string
  Contracts []string
  Guarantees []string
  Scope Scope
type ServiceReference struct
  Provider string
  Capability string
  Contract string
  Guarantees []string
  Scope Scope
  Transport string
  Endpoint string
type ResolveResult struct
  Status ResolutionStatus
  Reference *ServiceReference
type BootstrapObservation struct
  State BootstrapState
  Detail string
type CapabilityObservation struct
  Request ResolveRequest
  Result *ResolveResult
type RuntimeObservation struct
  Bootstrap BootstrapObservation
  Capabilities []CapabilityObservation
type CallerAttribute struct
  Attribute string
  Proof string
  Ceiling string
type CallerObservation struct
  Outcome CallerOutcome
  Mechanism string
  Account string
  Program string
  PID int64
  Attributes []CallerAttribute
  Platform string
  Transport string
  Bindable bool
  Stronger string
type ServiceState struct
  Contract string
  Readiness ServiceReadiness
  Why string
  Guarantees []string
  Capabilities map[string]string
type Description struct
  Outcome DescriptionOutcome
  Program string
  Version string
  Services []ServiceState
type RemoteTrust struct
  ServerName string
  Roots string
  Certificate string
  Key string
  Credential string
type Declaration struct
  Name string
  Program string
  Arguments []string
  Endpoint string
  Transport DeclarationTransport
  Contracts []string
  Guarantees []string
  Resources []string
  Activation Activation
  Remote *RemoteTrust
  Models []string
type DeclarationState struct
  Declaration Declaration
  DeclaredBy string
  DeclaredUnixMs int64
  Readiness DeclarationReadiness
  Why string
  Restarts int64
  Described []ServiceState
  Accepted []string
type DeclarationList struct
  Outcome DeclarationListOutcome
  Revision string
  Declarations []DeclarationState
type DeclarationChange struct
  Outcome DeclarationEditOutcome
  Revision string
  Reason string
type DeclarationObservation struct
  Outcome DeclarationListOutcome
  Cursor string
  Declarations []DeclarationState
type ApplicationInterface struct
  Name string
  Protocol string
  Contract string
type ApplicationActivationRecipe struct
  Arguments []string
  Readiness ApplicationInterface
  ReadinessTimeoutMs int64
type ApplicationDescriptor struct
  Name string
  Program string
  Title string
  StartGuidance string
  Activation *ApplicationActivationRecipe
type ApplicationContext struct
  Name string
  Title string
  Revision string
type ApplicationPresence struct
  Application string
  Instance string
  Interfaces []ApplicationInterface
  Contexts []ApplicationContext
  LeaseMs int64
type ApplicationInstance struct
  Instance string
  Interfaces []ApplicationInterface
  Contexts []ApplicationContext
  ExpiresUnixMs int64
type ApplicationEntry struct
  Descriptor ApplicationDescriptor
  Instances []ApplicationInstance
  Scope Scope
type ApplicationChange struct
  Outcome ApplicationOutcome
  Instance string
  Reason string
type ApplicationPage struct
  Outcome ApplicationOutcome
  Cursor string
  Applications []ApplicationEntry
type ApplicationActivationResult struct
  Outcome ApplicationActivationOutcome
  Instance string
  Started bool
  Reason string

  Offset int

  ExchangeFrame(frame []byte) ([]byte, error)

  Message string

const EndpointContract

  Resolve(request ResolveRequest) (ResolveResult, error)

  FrameExchanger

  Handler Resolver

func (ResolverDispatcher) WriteFrame(frame []byte) error

type Registry interface
  Declarations() (DeclarationList, error)
  Declare(expectedRevision string, declaration Declaration) (DeclarationChange, error)
  Withdraw(expectedRevision, name string) (DeclarationChange, error)
  Observe(cursor string, waitMs int64) (DeclarationObservation, error)
type RegistryTransport interface
  FrameExchanger
type RegistryClient struct
func NewRegistryClient(t RegistryTransport) *RegistryClient
type RegistryDispatcher struct
  Handler Registry
func (RegistryClient) Declarations() (result DeclarationList, err error)
func (RegistryClient) Declare(expectedRevision string, declaration Declaration) (result DeclarationChange, err error)
func (RegistryClient) Withdraw(expectedRevision, name string) (result DeclarationChange, err error)
func (RegistryClient) Observe(cursor string, waitMs int64) (result DeclarationObservation, err error)
func (RegistryDispatcher) DescribeService() (contract string, ready bool, why string)
func (RegistryDispatcher) ServiceContract() string
func (RegistryDispatcher) WriteFrame(frame []byte) error
func (RegistryDispatcher) ExchangeFrame(frame []byte) ([]byte, error)
type Applications interface
  Register(descriptor ApplicationDescriptor) (ApplicationChange, error)
  Remove(application string) (ApplicationChange, error)
  Announce(presence ApplicationPresence) (ApplicationChange, error)
  Withdraw(application, instance string) (ApplicationChange, error)
  Observe(cursor string, waitMs int64) (ApplicationPage, error)
  Activate(application string) (ApplicationActivationResult, error)
type ApplicationsTransport interface
  FrameExchanger
type ApplicationsClient struct
func NewApplicationsClient(t ApplicationsTransport) *ApplicationsClient
type ApplicationsDispatcher struct
  Handler Applications
func (ApplicationsClient) Register(descriptor ApplicationDescriptor) (result ApplicationChange, err error)
func (ApplicationsClient) Remove(application string) (result ApplicationChange, err error)
func (ApplicationsClient) Announce(presence ApplicationPresence) (result ApplicationChange, err error)
func (ApplicationsClient) Withdraw(application, instance string) (result ApplicationChange, err error)
func (ApplicationsClient) Observe(cursor string, waitMs int64) (result ApplicationPage, err error)
func (ApplicationsClient) Activate(application string) (result ApplicationActivationResult, err error)
func (ApplicationsDispatcher) DescribeService() (contract string, ready bool, why string)
func (ApplicationsDispatcher) ServiceContract() string
func (ApplicationsDispatcher) WriteFrame(frame []byte) error
func (ApplicationsDispatcher) ExchangeFrame(frame []byte) ([]byte, error)
